build_residual_network: build a residual network by wrapping layers with ResidualWrapper and chaining them in a Sequential model
create_residual_wrapper: create a ResidualWrapper instance that wraps a single nn.Module to add residual connections
test_residual_forward: test the ResidualWrapper forward pass by passing a tensor and verifying output equals input plus module output
review_residual_wrapper_init: review the ResidualWrapper __init__ method to understand how it stores the wrapped module
summarize_residual_forward: summarize the ResidualWrapper forward method which computes x + module(x) for residual learning
